description: This file declares functions related to parsing function schemas and operator names within the TorchScript JIT component. It primarily contains function declarations and includes relevant headers.

methods.name: parseSchemaOrName
methods.description: Parses a string into either an OperatorName or a FunctionSchema, with optional support for type variables.

methods.name: parseSchema
methods.description: Parses a schema string into a FunctionSchema object, with optional support for type variables.

methods.name: parseName
methods.description: Parses a name string into an OperatorName object.
